en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal urban scene dominated by a large round stone tower with crenellations and a flag on top, located on a waterfront promenade beside a landscaped traffic circle with trees, cars, and pedestrians. The sea and a ship are visible in the background. Greek and French captions are printed along the bottom margin, and the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' is overprinted on the image.
